name: Quasit
summary: A tiny demon that rends with poisoned claws, scares foes, turns invisible, and shape-shifts.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The quasit has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Rend
actions.onHit: and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the quasit's next turn.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.text: The quasit casts *{ref:spell/invisibility}* on itself, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability.

actions.name: Scare
actions.onFailure: The target has the Frightened condition. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

actions.name: Shape-Shift
actions.text: The quasit shape-shifts to resemble a bat (Speed 10 ft., Fly 40 ft.), a centipede (40 ft., Climb 40 ft.), or a toad (40 ft., Swim 40 ft.), or it returns to its true form. Its game statistics are the same in each form, except for its Speed. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.
